name: Valmuda Lekzabrutska
original_name: ヴァルミューダ・レクザブルツカ
source:
Profession: Underworld Princess
Country: The Underground Empire, Avatar
Race: Vampire
Height: About Average
Breast size: Big

There is a vast underground world in this earth. There, a race different from humans prosper and rule.....

The emperor of this dark world wanted the strongest children from his daughter. He heard rumors about the advent of the hero and ordered his daughter to entangle the man. 

Valmuda didn't feel like listening to her father's orders, but she was interested in the terrestrial world she hadn't seen yet, and eventually visited Essenbaum. Then, she met the hero.

"It's the first time I know a man I care about. You're the right man for me to get blood from for the first time."
